messages.subject: R-Project Google Summer of Code Dashboard
parts:
Hi Org Admins, Mentors and Students,

Hope you are safe and well.

We have updated the data for the R-GSoC Dashboard on R Community Explorer. The underlying data can be found here: https://github.com/benubah/r-community-explorer/blob/master/docs/data/gsoc.csv
After making student and mentor names consistent across all 13 years of data, we may have missed some. This is because some participant provide just google usernames, but in other years they return with full names, making some mentors and students appear with different names over the years.
Please report any cases of misspelled names, different representations of the same name, etc

Feel free to suggest any other features you think that could make this dashboard of greater utility.

If you could help with providing a link to this dashboard on the https://www.r-project.org/ website, it would be appreciated.

Wish you all a wonderful coding season!

Cheers,
Ben
